question: 单项选择：I saw him _____ football yesterday. A. play  B. to play  C. playing  D. plays
answer: 答案：A. play。解析：see sb. do"看到...做了（全过程）"。yesterday是过去时。

question: 单项选择：I saw him _____ football when I passed by. A. play  B. playing  C. to play  D. played
answer: 答案：B. playing。解析：see sb. doing"看到...正在做"。when I passed by"我路过时"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：We heard her ______ (sing) in the next room just now.
answer: 答案：singing。解析：hear sb. doing"听到...正在做"。just now"刚才"。

question: 单项选择：I often hear him _____ English in the morning. A. read  B. reading  C. to read  D. reads
answer: 答案：A. read。解析：hear sb. do"听到...做（经常）"。in the morning"早上"。

question: 翻译句子：我看见她正在过马路。
answer: 答案：I saw her crossing the road. 解析：see sb. doing"看到...正在做"。cross the road"过马路"。

question: 单项选择：Did you notice anyone _____ the flowers? A. water  B. watering  C. to water  D. watered
answer: 答案：B. watering。解析：notice sb. doing"注意到...正在做"。the flowers"花"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：He watched the children ______ (play) in the park.
answer: 答案：playing。解析：watch sb. doing"观看...正在做"。in the park"在公园里"。

question: 单项选择：I heard someone _____ at the door just now. A. knock  B. knocking  C. to knock  D. knocked
answer: 答案：B. knocking。解析：hear sb. doing"听到...正在做"。just now"刚才"。

question: 翻译句子：我感觉到有人在碰我的手。
answer: 答案：I felt someone touching my hand. 解析：feel sb. doing"感觉到...正在做"。touch"碰/摸"。

question: 单项选择：She noticed a man _____ something into his pocket. A. put  B. putting  C. to put  D. puts
answer: 答案：B. putting。解析：notice sb. doing"注意到...正在做"。into his pocket"进口袋"。
